title: Cultural Perspectives and Expectations for Generative AI: A Global Survey Approach

bias_targets.methodology: A large-scale cross-national survey across 13 countries assessing how global populations define culture, identifying important cultural artifacts, and measuring user perceptions of GenAI's potential for cultural misrepresentation and stereotyping.
Surveying participants to evaluate the importance and perceived representational sensitivity of 'Religion or tradition' in GenAI, identifying it as a primary 'cultural redline'.
Measuring the perceived sensitivity of GenAI depicting nationality and geographical belonging through self-reported survey rankings across diverse global regions.
Asking survey respondents to rank the cultural importance and GenAI representational sensitivity of identities such as race, color, ethnicity, and tribe.
Collecting user sensitivity ratings and importance rankings regarding GenAI depictions of socioeconomic status, education level, and occupation or profession.
Analyzing survey responses, highlighting regional specificities (e.g., in India and the UAE), to determine the perceived sensitivity of GenAI representing caste identities.
